# Engineering — David Awad

**URL:** https://davidaw.ad/engineering
**LLM version:** https://davidaw.ad/engineering/llms.txt

Selected software, machine-learning, embedded, and legal-tech projects.

---
## fpml-rs — 2026 [tool] — published 2026-10-30 (https://github.com/davidawad/fpml-rs) (date: first GitHub release published_at)
Typed Rust bindings for FpML credit default swap confirmations: parse ISDA's XML into real types, read the headline terms, and write it back without silently dropping elements.

## cftc-rs — 2026 [tool] — published 2026-10-29 (https://github.com/davidawad/cftc-rs) (date: first GitHub release published_at)
Read the CDS market from the free DTCC public swap tape: any date range, typed trades, daily spread series per company or index, and bond-to-ticker mapping (Rust library and CLI).

## hetzner-rs — 2026 [tool] — published 2026-10-27 (https://github.com/davidawad/hetzner-rs) (date: first GitHub release published_at)
Rust client for the Hetzner Cloud API, generated from the official OpenAPI spec, with a blocking shim, idempotent-only retry and secret redaction.

## ubicloud-rs — 2026 [tool] — published 2026-10-27 (https://github.com/davidawad/ubicloud-rs) (date: first GitHub release published_at)
Rust client for the Ubicloud API, generated from the official OpenAPI spec with a blocking shim, retry backoff and secret redaction.

## whatsapp-link — 2026 [tool] — published 2026-10-27 (https://github.com/davidawad/whatsapp-link-rs) (date: GitHub repository made public)
Rust library and CLI that links a WhatsApp account and reads and sends messages by driving wuzapi over stdio JSON-RPC.

## slack-impersona — 2026 [tool] — published 2026-10-27 (https://github.com/davidawad/slack-impersona-rs) (date: GitHub repository made public)
Rust client and CLI for Slack's Web API that authenticates with a browser session's token and cookie instead of a registered Slack app.

## finance-rs — 2026 [tool] — published 2026-10-27 (https://github.com/davidawad/finance-rs) (date: first GitHub release published_at)
Composable financial math for Rust: TVM, XIRR/XNPV, day counts, amortization, portfolio metrics, real estate, venture and fund waterfalls, fixed income.

## kd-library-tooling — 2026 [tool] — published 2026-10-27 (https://github.com/davidawad/kd-library-tooling) (date: first GitHub release published_at)
kb-root: resolves a knowledge base's configured directories and checks their paths stay consistent.

## wherebox-cli — 2026 [tool] — published 2026-10-26 (https://github.com/davidawad/wherebox-cli) (date: first GitHub release published_at)
Command-line home inventory: what you own, where it is and what it is worth, in one encrypted local database per property, with Homebox CSV import and export.

## bm — 2026 [tool] — published 2026-10-26 (https://github.com/davidawad/bm) (date: first GitHub release published_at (v0.1.0, 2026-10-26T04:59:28Z))
Browser-independent bookmark store in Bend 2: pulls and merges bookmarks from any browser, keeps folders, classifies new ones, exports csv, json, toon and html.

## cswap-bend — 2026 [tool] — published 2026-10-26 (https://github.com/davidawad/cswap-bend) (date: first GitHub release published_at)
claude-swap rewritten in Bend 2: keeps several Claude Code accounts, reads each one's 5-hour and 7-day usage, and switches the active login before one runs out.

## bend-toon — 2026 [tool] — published 2026-10-26 (https://github.com/davidawad/bend-toon) (date: first GitHub release published_at)
TOON (spec v3.3) encoder and decoder for Bend 2; passes all 389 conformance cases (written in Bend).

## bend-lint-rules — 2026 [tool] — published 2026-10-24 (https://github.com/davidawad/bend-lint-rules) (date: first GitHub release published_at (v0.1.0, 2026-10-24T08:36:08Z))
Lint rules for Bend 2 programs: dead defs, call-graph fan-in and fan-out, and cyclomatic and cognitive complexity, for the official bend-lint.

## bend-semver-checks — 2026 [tool] — published 2026-10-24 (https://github.com/davidawad/bend-semver-checks) (date: first GitHub release published_at)
cargo-semver-checks for Bend 2: diffs two versions of a LAWS.bend and flags removed or weakened laws (written in Bend).

## hx-highlight — 2026 [tool] — published 2026-10-14 (https://github.com/davidawad/hx-highlight) (date: first GitHub release published_at)
Syntax highlighting for contract-defined terms in the Helix editor.

## health-cli — 2026 [tool] — published 2026-10-14 (https://github.com/davidawad/health-cli) (date: first GitHub release published_at)
health data store + workbook generator

## formbook — 2026 [legal-tech] — published 2026-10-14 (https://github.com/davidawad/formbook) (date: first GitHub release published_at)
Open collection of court-filing templates written in Typst; each template takes Markdown with a YAML header and is organized by court and document type.

## snaptrade-rs — 2026 [tool] — published 2026-10-12 (https://github.com/davidawad/snaptrade-rs) (date: GitHub repository created_at (public repo))
Unofficial, strongly typed Rust client for the SnapTrade brokerage-aggregation API (signed requests, typed models, pagination, backoff; trading behind an off-by-default feature)

## condorcet — 2026 [tool] — published 2026-10-11 (https://github.com/davidawad/condorcet) (date: GitHub repository created_at (public repo))
Fact-composition engine: SAT core, weighted model counting, Dung argumentation, JSON-declared composers

## shelfmark — 2026 [tool] — published 2026-10-11 (https://github.com/davidawad/shelfmark) (date: GitHub repository created_at (public repo))
Open classification schemes for personal libraries, and a benchmark for scoring them

## health-charts.el — 2026 [tool] — published 2026-10-07 (https://github.com/davidawad/health-charts.el) (date: first GitHub release published_at)
Health and biomarker charts and Org reports in Emacs (Vega-Lite and gnuplot)

## financial-charts.el — 2026 [tool] — published 2026-10-07 (https://github.com/davidawad/financial-charts.el) (date: first GitHub release published_at)
Financial charts in Emacs: candlesticks, area, line, sparkline, option payoff and P/L bars as unicode text or SVG, from plain Lisp data. Validate/explain/describe API and a JSON CLI.

## eas.el — 2026 [tool] — published 2026-10-06 (https://github.com/davidawad/eas.el) (date: first GitHub release published_at)
eas.el: an Emacs-native, interactive, agent-drivable chart engine (Vega-Lite subset, SVG + terminal text)

## genome-cli — 2026 [tool] — published 2026-10-05 (https://github.com/davidawad/genome-cli) (date: first GitHub release published_at)
Personal genomic data CLI: 23andMe/Ancestry array exports, whole-genome VCF and FASTQ, encrypted at rest

## genetics.el — 2026 [tool] — published 2026-10-05 (https://github.com/davidawad/genetics.el) (date: GitHub repository created_at (public repo))
Emacs package for consumer genetics raw data: 23andMe/Ancestry/MyHeritage/FTDNA exports, whole-genome VCFs and FASTQ via genome-cli

## fastq-mode — 2026 [tool] — published 2026-10-05 (https://github.com/davidawad/fastq-mode) (date: GitHub repository created_at (public repo))
Fast FASTQ viewer for Emacs: streaming .fastq.gz, base and quality coloring, Phred at point, stats

## whatsapp-link-rs — 2026 [tool] — published 2026-10-05 (https://github.com/davidawad/whatsapp-link-rs) (date: GitHub repository created_at (public repo))
Link a WhatsApp account and read and send messages from Rust, by driving wuzapi over stdio JSON-RPC

## slack-impersona-rs — 2026 [tool] — published 2026-10-05 (https://github.com/davidawad/slack-impersona-rs) (date: GitHub repository created_at (public repo))
Rust library and CLI for Slack's Web API as a signed-in user (xoxc token + d cookie); read-only by default, no Slack app

## litgraph — 2026 [legal-tech] — published 2026-09-29 (https://github.com/davidawad/litgraph) (date: first GitHub release published_at)

Tree-sitter grammar for Bend 2, plus a Vim/Neovim plugin (classic syntax layer for both, tree-sitter highlighting for Neovim)

Emacs major mode for Bend 2 (bendlang/bend): syntax highlighting, indentation, Eglot formatting, and Flymake diagnostics.

## chwrite — 2026 [tool] — published 2026-08-10 (https://github.com/davidawad/chwrite) (date: GitHub repository created_at (public repo))
Flexible file-write lock so coding agents can't write sensitive code. Configure once and self-installs on clone.

## Civ Pro: The Gathering — 2026 [legal-tech] (https://civ-pro-the-gathering-97ee4c.gitlab.io/drill/ | https://civ-pro-the-gathering-97ee4c.gitlab.io/drill/)
Papers, Please for the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure — drill litigation situations, get sanctioned by rule and subsection when you blow one.

## Contract Variable Highlighter — 2024 [legal-tech]
VS Code-style highlighter that finds and color-codes every defined term in a contract so lawyers can spot drafting errors.

## TISLA Student Loan FAQ — 2021 [legal-tech] (https://github.com/davidawad/TISLA_FAQ)

## thoth — 2020 [tool] (https://github.com/DavidAwad/thoth)

## Read-Between-The-Lines — 2018 [legal-tech] (https://github.com/DavidAwad/Read-Between-The-Lines)
NLP tool that diffs two versions of a contract and surfaces the meaningful changes.

## capstone — 2018 [ml] (https://github.com/DavidAwad/capstone)
Self-driving car capstone — full ROS stack, perception + planning + control.

## traffic-sign-classifier — 2017 [ml] (https://github.com/DavidAwad/traffic-sign-classifier)
Deep CNN that classifies German traffic signs — Udacity self-driving car nanodegree.

## lane-detection — 2017 [ml] (https://github.com/DavidAwad/lane-detection)
OpenCV pipeline that detects lane lines from a forward-facing dashcam feed.

## Behavioral-Cloning — 2017 [ml] (https://github.com/DavidAwad/Behavioral-Cloning)
End-to-end neural net that learns to steer a car from front-camera frames alone.

## hi.rd — 2017 [web] (https://github.com/DavidAwad/hi.rd)
Tiny URL shortener with click analytics.

## vehicle-detection — 2017 [ml] (https://github.com/DavidAwad/vehicle-detection)
SVM + HOG features pipeline that boxes every car in a dashcam frame.

## advanced-lane-detection — 2017 [ml] (https://github.com/DavidAwad/advanced-lane-detection)
Perspective-warp + polynomial fit that tracks curved lane lines under shadow and glare.

## insightweets — 2016 [web] (https://github.com/DavidAwad/insightweets)
Sentiment analysis dashboard for a Twitter user's timeline.

## Archangel Raphael's Mission — 2016 [nonprofit] (http://armnewbrunswick.org)

## blocky — 2016 [web] (https://github.com/DavidAwad/blocky)

## ironmyo — 2016 [embedded] (https://github.com/DavidAwad/ironmyo)

## Waves — 2016 [physics] (https://github.com/DavidAwad/Waves)
Numerical simulation of the 2D wave equation, written for an undergrad PDE course.

## kinectsentrygun — 2015 [embedded] (https://github.com/DavidAwad/kinectsentrygun)

## spaceshare — 2015 [web] (https://github.com/DavidAwad/spaceshare)
